gdpr.question: What about GDPR?
gdpr.answer: We sign a data processing agreement. The automation processes only the data needed for the task, and I choose tools that keep the data in the European Union. Where AI isn't needed, the data never reaches it.

security.question: Is my data safe?
security.answer: I pick the tools for the job, e.g. n8n for process automation or LangGraph for AI agents. Everything can run on your own server or on a dedicated server in the EU rather than a shared service. I only get access to your systems to the extent the automation needs, and I choose AI providers that don't train models on data sent through their API.

integrations.question: Will it work with the software I use?
integrations.answer: Usually, yes. I connect to software through APIs or file imports, as well as to email, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, spreadsheets, CRMs and messaging apps. During the analysis I check what can be connected in your case before quoting anything.

webApps.question: What kind of web applications do you build?
webApps.answer: Custom applications: client portals, internal systems for handling orders or requests, and first versions (MVPs) of new products. I build them with Next.js, React and TypeScript, and after launch I can take care of hosting and maintenance. If the application is meant to work with automations or AI agents, I design it as one whole from the start.

failure.question: What if something stops working?
failure.answer: The automation reports errors immediately, so I usually know about a problem before you do. As part of support I fix issues and adjust the workflow when, for example, your software or document format changes. Important processes also have a fallback.

duration.question: How long does implementation take?
duration.answer: A simple automation, such as reminders, usually goes live in 1–2 weeks. Solutions that use AI to read documents and connect several systems take longer, and I build applications in stages so the first version works as soon as possible. You get an exact timeline together with the quote.

technical.question: Do I need to be technical?
technical.answer: No. Just tell me how work in your business looks today. I take care of the technical side, and at the end I show you how to use the solution.
